calls.statement:
SELECT s.store_key, s.store_id, s.store_name, s.city, s.region, s.format, s.open_date, s.close_date, s.valid_from, s.valid_to, s.is_current,
 (SELECT period_start_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5) AS p5_start,
 (SELECT period_end_date FROM ref_fiscal_calendar WHERE fiscal_year='FY2026/27' AND fiscal_period=5) AS p5_end
FROM dim_store s WHERE s.store_id=102 OR s.store_name ILIKE '%Pit%' ORDER BY s.store_key

calls.statement:
SELECT 'sales_lines' AS what, COUNT(*) AS n_rows, COUNT(DISTINCT sales_line_id) AS d_line_id, COUNT(DISTINCT (receipt_id, line_no)) AS d_receipt_line, SUM(quantity) AS units,
  SUM(CASE WHEN p.category='ZZ Test' THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS test_units, SUM(CASE WHEN staff_purchase_flag THEN quantity ELSE 0 END) AS staff_units, MIN(quantity) AS minq
FROM fact_sales_line f JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
UNION ALL
SELECT 'rpt', COUNT(*), NULL, NULL, SUM(units_sold), NULL, NULL, NULL FROM rpt_daily_store_sales WHERE store_id=102 AND business_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'

calls.statement:
SELECT cp.sku, cp.product_name, cp.category, cp.subcategory, SUM(f.quantity) AS units_sold, COUNT(DISTINCT p.product_key) AS versions
FROM fact_sales_line f
JOIN dim_store s ON s.store_key=f.store_key
JOIN dim_product p ON p.product_key=f.product_key
JOIN dim_product cp ON cp.sku=p.sku AND cp.is_current
WHERE s.store_id=102 AND p.category <> 'ZZ Test'
  AND f.sale_date BETWEEN DATE '2026-08-31' AND DATE '2026-09-27'
GROUP BY 1,2,3,4 ORDER BY units_sold DESC, cp.sku LIMIT 8
